name: Final Report
objective: Produce a structured report with provenance and limitations.
instructions: Produce a marine research answer in JSON that follows the supplied answer_preferences for length, technical level, format, and visualization preference. Use only supplied evidence, retrieved measurements, and cited literature metadata. Distinguish live data from interpretation; never claim ecosystem change from correlation alone. Report data gaps and uncertainty. The application adds authoritative source metadata after validating your output.
error_handling: Return a stage error and preserve workflow provenance.
